leftEvidence.title: Zechariah blesses God for a horn in David’s house

points.label: Action and response
points.left: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Zechariah blesses God for visiting and redeeming, raising a horn of salvation in David’s house, speaking through prophets, and remembering covenant and oath.
points.right: Registration moves Joseph and Mary from Nazareth to Bethlehem because he belongs to David’s house; Jesus is born, and an angel announces a Savior, Christ the Lord, in David’s city.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The source places Davidic house language is joined to covenant memory and deliverance inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
points.right: The source places Davidic descent and city locate the birth announcement inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.

payload.posture: Luke 1:67–75 and Luke 2:1–14 are distinct approved David Scenes in the authored “Gospel and Apostolic Memory” movement; holding them together exposes what continues and what changes without collapsing their sources.
